procedure.action: Create a separate record for each requested observed Cmax, observed Tmax and AUC endpoint.
procedure.handoff_condition: Downstream calculation requires the endpoint's applicable preflight and method approvals. Unresolved sampling adequacy blocks that endpoint, not independent supported endpoints.

procedure.action: Compare the proposal-defined interval with available observation times and specify boundary handling without calculating exposure.
candidate_options: Use an observed boundary concentration when available and applicable to the defined dose interval.
If the boundary lies between applicable observations, propose an appropriate interpolation rule with its assumptions and rationale.
If the boundary lies outside observed support, explicitly identify extrapolation and its additional evidence needs; do not call it interpolation.
For time zero, distinguish pre-dose from post-dose and single from repeated dosing; do not automatically insert zero concentration.
Refer terminal extrapolation for AUCinf to MP002.
procedure.current_scope: Propose and document the method; numerical contributions and diagnostics belong to the later analysis report.

procedure.action: Label data origin, aggregation and sampling design separately, then bind the estimand to that level.
procedure.group_mean_estimand: Exposure under the reconstructed measured group-summary curve. Do not label it as an individual AUC distribution or an individual peak summary.
not_permitted: Invent animal IDs or within-animal trajectories
Treat fitted/predicted curves as measured group means
Invent SD/SE, covariance or confidence intervals
